title: Pentaryn Movement
description: Players' own tokens draw on top for them (client-side: their tokens take the click when tokens overlap; nothing is written to the scene). A ghost button in the token tools lets a player move their own tokens through walls and creatures, reusing core's unconstrained-movement constrain options (ignoreWalls, ignoreCost, and dnd5e's ignoreTokens); their tokens look see-through while it is on. The GM governs it with a world setting (Off / Exploration only / Always allowed; Exploration only switches it off while a combat is running on the scene) and a toolbar button that flips it off and back. An incorporeal creature (a feat named Incorporeal Passage / Movement or Ethereal, or the GM's Token HUD toggle) keeps ghosting during a fight. Drag help in three tiers, each with its own switch: A, dragging a token past a wall or a token standing in the way finds the shortest way around it (A* on the grid, open doors only, a large token only where it fits, players only round walls they have seen), and clicking a moving token stops it exactly where it is drawn (in a fight at the next square, so the movement spent stays exact); B, several tokens dragged together out of combat each walk their own way to their own spot, filing through doors without overlapping, other drags read through server-ordered reservations and a runtime yield guard; C (off by default), several tokens dragged together in a fight kept apart by space: members whose ways never meet set off together, the others on the arrival of the one before them. Tokens that start stacked stay stacked; every wait ends by the move's one 10 s deadline; players see two notices (No route there; Stopped short, way blocked). Fail-open to core's move, a circuit breaker that switches the drag help off after repeated failures and tells the GM, per-client telemetry and an Alt+W key that files the last ten seconds through pentaryn-feedback. A GM toolbar button turns the drag help off for the table. Exposes game.pentaryn.movement.

afterSync: First install: restart Foundry (module.json is read at startup), enable 'Pentaryn Movement', then reload.
Players get a Ghost toggle in the token tools; the GM sets the policy in settings.
